title: OpenCinema node plugin install package
description: install.json produced by createNodeConfig: one React ESM module, its manifest and hashed assets. Install it from Settings → 插件, from the plugin market, or with the installPluginPackage / installMarketplacePlugin workbench tools.

source.description: ESM source of the plugin entry (default export is the NodePluginDefinition). At most 20 MiB. Imports react, react-dom and zod resolve to the host /pluginSdk.js.

path.description: Relative path next to index.js, e.g. assets/a1b2.css or assets/model.wasm. No '..' and no hidden segments.

id.description: Lower camel case plugin id; also the node type (the canvas stores it as remote-<id>).

version.description: Semantic version from the plugin package.json.

description.description: One sentence: what the node does. Shown in the market, the node menu and to agents.

requires.description: Host capability versions the plugin needs, e.g. {"workspaceFiles":1,"ffmpeg":1,"worker":1}.

configRules.description: Settings fields the host renders and agents may read/write through getPluginConfiguration / setPluginConfiguration.

agentGuide.description: Operating guide for agents (from agent.md): which tools to call in what order, how to confirm results, limits.
